Definition: Country identifiers.
Whether the country appears in each ISSP/ISPSS wave.
Calendar year, 2010-2022.
Total resident population. World Bank WDI SP.POP.TOTL, mid-year, for 39 countries; Taiwan is the MOI year-end registered population.
Caution / verification: Verified: all 507 World Bank values matched the live API exactly.

Definition: Alternative population from UN WPP 2024, total population at 1 July, for all 40 countries including Taiwan.
Caution / verification: Verified: all 520 values matched the live UN WPP 2024 file exactly.

Definition: Percentage gap between the two population series.
Caution / verification: Use to see where the choice of population denominator matters.

Definition: Residents born outside the reporting country.
Caution / verification: Includes naturalised citizens, so it exceeds foreign_nationals almost everywhere.

Definition: Residents holding foreign citizenship, including stateless where reported.
Caution / verification: Conceptually the closest available match to "non-nationals" using public healthcare. RECOMMENDED as the main cross-national regressor.

Definition: Estimated number of foreign nationals resident without authorisation.
Caution / verification: WEAK. 13/40 countries. Methods not comparable across countries.

Definition: Administrative register count of persons remaining beyond authorised stay.
Caution / verification: WEAK. 5/40 countries. A register count, not a modelled stock.

Definition: Taiwan only: Ministry of Labor count of absconded / missing migrant workers (失聯移工).
Caution / verification: A SUBSET of overstayers. Kept separate so it is never read as the same series.

Definition: Third-country nationals found to be illegally present during the year.
Caution / verification: A FLOW of enforcement events, NOT a stock, and not a count of persons - one person can be detected more than once.

Definition: Variable divided by population (proportion, not percent).
Detections per 1,000 residents.
Caution / verification: Provided because a raw flow is not comparable to a stock share.

Definition: Reference date of the underlying measurement.
Caution / verification: Eurostat/OECD stocks are 1 January; Taiwan and Korea are 31 December; Japan is 1 January.

Definition: Provenance of each value.

Data-quality grade for that cell. A = re-derived from a machine-readable official source and matched exactly, or corrected against one during this verification. B = the published figure appears in the retrieved source document. C = derived from the source rather than published by it (see *_derived and *_published_range). Values that could not be traced to an archived source were deleted, so no grade D remains.
Caution / verification: Every retained value is traceable to an archived source file.

Definition: Flag: "yes" when the cell is derived from the source rather than published by it.
Caution / verification: Marked with ≈ on the website. 13 such values, all midpoints of published ranges.

Definition: How the value was derived, e.g. "midpoint of the published range".
Caution / verification: Empty when the value is published directly by the source.

Definition: The range the source actually publishes, where it publishes a range rather than a point estimate.
Caution / verification: Use the range, not the derived midpoint, for any claim about level.
